location.name: Southern Hemlock Bridge
location.description: An old timber bridge at the forest edge. Blue motes have gathered beneath its southern rail.

party.name: Soren Hazel
party.goal: Help Renn understand the motes while keeping the group hopeful.

party.name: Lupin
party.goal: Protect the group and watch for physical danger or hidden routes.

active_entities.known: A long-eared figure has been glimpsed near the fern line.

open_pressures: The motes are gathering around the southern rail.
Tracks end where the blue light begins.
The Crown Hare may reveal or conceal the route beneath the bridge.
sealed_clues: A warning concerns the lantern keeper.
